name: Whatsapp Button
description: Provides a configurable block that renders a WhatsApp click-to-chat button.
project_description: The WhatsApp Button module adds a single configurable block that renders a floating WhatsApp click-to-chat button. Each placed block instance carries its own settings: the destination phone number, a pre-filled message, a tooltip, optional text beside the icon, a custom icon image (falling back to the bundled WhatsApp logo), the button's bottom/right position, and per-device (tablet/desktop) overrides for image width and position via CSS media queries. Clicking the button opens https://api.whatsapp.com/send with the number and message pre-populated. It requires no modules beyond Drupal core and provides no routes, permissions, services, or Drush commands of its own.
